title: Summarize a quarterly revenue update
prompt: Summarize the following in one sentence: Q3 revenue grew 12% year over year driven by strong subscription renewals, though new customer acquisition slowed compared to Q2 due to increased competition.

metadata.notes: Correct: captures both the revenue growth (12% YoY, driven by renewals) and the slowdown in new customer acquisition (due to competition) — a summary that drops either half is incomplete.
metadata.grading_method: manual (reviewed 2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) - the revenue half has a strong anchor (12%), but the acquisition-slowdown half is conceptual/paraphrase-prone with no equally reliable anchor. Checking only the strong half would silently accept a summary that drops the acquisition half entirely, which the rubric explicitly marks as a failure - not auto-graded rather than under-check half the rubric.
